results.question: How many trades failed this week?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS trades_count
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_TRADES t
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_SETTLEMENTS s ON s.trade_id = t.trade_id
WHERE s.settlement_status = 'FAILED'
  AND t.trade_status <> 'CANCELLED'
  AND s.expected_settle_date BETWEEN '2026-11-16' AND '2026-11-20'

results.question: Total notional by counterparty this week
results.sql:
SELECT c.counterparty_name, SUM(t.notional_usd) AS total_notional_usd
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_TRADES t
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.DIM_COUNTERPARTY c ON c.counterparty_id = t.counterparty_id
WHERE t.trade_status <> 'CANCELLED'
  AND t.trade_date BETWEEN '2026-11-16' AND '2026-11-20'
GROUP BY c.counterparty_name
ORDER BY total_notional_usd DESC

results.question: List pending trades over $2M
results.sql:
SELECT t.trade_id, t.trade_date, x.ticker, t.side, t.notional_usd, c.counterparty_name, s.expected_settle_date, s.settlement_status, s.fail_reason, s.days_failing
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_TRADES t
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_SETTLEMENTS s ON s.trade_id = t.trade_id
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.DIM_COUNTERPARTY c ON c.counterparty_id = t.counterparty_id
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.DIM_SECURITY x ON x.security_id = t.security_id
WHERE s.settlement_status = 'PENDING'
  AND t.trade_status <> 'CANCELLED'
  AND t.notional_usd > 2000000

results.question: Market value by desk
results.sql:
SELECT a.desk, SUM(p.market_value_usd) AS total_market_value_usd
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_POSITIONS p
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.DIM_ACCOUNT a ON a.account_id = p.account_id
WHERE p.as_of_date = '2026-11-20'
GROUP BY a.desk
ORDER BY total_market_value_usd DESC

results.question: Open breaks by account
results.sql:
SELECT a.account_name, COUNT(*) AS breaks_count
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_BREAKS b
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.DIM_ACCOUNT a ON a.account_id = b.account_id
WHERE b.break_status IN ('OPEN', 'INVESTIGATING')
GROUP BY a.account_name
ORDER BY breaks_count DESC

results.question: Top 3 traders by notional this month
results.sql:
SELECT t.trader, SUM(t.notional_usd) AS total_notional_usd
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_TRADES t
WHERE t.trade_status <> 'CANCELLED'
  AND t.trade_date BETWEEN '2026-11-01' AND '2026-11-20'
GROUP BY t.trader
ORDER BY total_notional_usd DESC
LIMIT 3

results.question: How many EUR trades today?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS trades_count
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_TRADES t
WHERE t.trade_status <> 'CANCELLED'
  AND t.trade_ccy = 'EUR'
  AND t.trade_date = '2026-11-20'

results.question: Failed trades by desk
results.sql:
SELECT a.desk, COUNT(*) AS trades_count
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_TRADES t
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_SETTLEMENTS s ON s.trade_id = t.trade_id
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.DIM_ACCOUNT a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE s.settlement_status = 'FAILED'
  AND t.trade_status <> 'CANCELLED'
GROUP BY a.desk
ORDER BY trades_count DESC

results.question: Average notional for ETF trades this month
results.sql:
SELECT AVG(t.notional_usd) AS avg_notional_usd
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_TRADES t
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.DIM_SECURITY x ON x.security_id = t.security_id
WHERE t.trade_status <> 'CANCELLED'
  AND x.asset_class = 'ETF'
  AND t.trade_date BETWEEN '2026-11-01' AND '2026-11-20'

results.question: Breaks by status
results.sql:
SELECT b.break_status, COUNT(*) AS breaks_count
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_BREAKS b
GROUP BY b.break_status
ORDER BY breaks_count DESC

results.question: Which securities have unsettled quantity?
results.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT x.ticker
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_POSITIONS p
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.DIM_SECURITY x ON x.security_id = p.security_id
WHERE p.as_of_date = '2026-11-20'
  AND p.traded_quantity <> p.settled_quantity

results.question: How many breaks were resolved last week?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS breaks_count
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_BREAKS b
WHERE b.break_status = 'RESOLVED'
  AND b.resolved_date BETWEEN '2026-11-09' AND '2026-11-13'

results.question: Notional by side this week
results.sql:
SELECT t.side, SUM(t.notional_usd) AS total_notional_usd
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_TRADES t
WHERE t.trade_status <> 'CANCELLED'
  AND t.trade_date BETWEEN '2026-11-16' AND '2026-11-20'
GROUP BY t.side
ORDER BY total_notional_usd DESC

results.question: What's the largest open break?
results.sql:
SELECT b.break_id, b.opened_date, a.account_name, b.break_type, b.break_status, b.amount_usd, b.age_days, b.owner_team, b.root_cause
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_BREAKS b
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.DIM_ACCOUNT a ON a.account_id = b.account_id
WHERE b.break_status IN ('OPEN', 'INVESTIGATING')
ORDER BY b.amount_usd DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: Show trades with Halden Securities today
results.sql:
SELECT t.trade_id, t.trade_date, x.ticker, t.side, t.quantity, t.notional_usd, c.counterparty_name
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_TRADES t
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.DIM_COUNTERPARTY c ON c.counterparty_id = t.counterparty_id
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.DIM_SECURITY x ON x.security_id = t.security_id
WHERE t.trade_status <> 'CANCELLED'
  AND c.counterparty_name = 'Halden Securities'
  AND t.trade_date = '2026-11-20'

results.question: Market value of corporate bonds
results.sql:
SELECT SUM(p.market_value_usd) AS total_market_value_usd
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_POSITIONS p
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.DIM_SECURITY x ON x.security_id = p.security_id
WHERE x.asset_class = 'CORP_BOND'
  AND p.as_of_date = '2026-11-20'

results.question: How many tier 2 counterparties are there?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS counterparties_count
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.DIM_COUNTERPARTY c
WHERE c.tier = 2

results.question: Failed trades by fail reason
results.sql:
SELECT s.fail_reason, COUNT(*) AS trades_count
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_TRADES t
JOIN TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_SETTLEMENTS s ON s.trade_id = t.trade_id
WHERE s.settlement_status = 'FAILED'
  AND t.trade_status <> 'CANCELLED'
GROUP BY s.fail_reason
ORDER BY trades_count DESC

results.question: Open break amount by owner team
results.sql:
SELECT b.owner_team, SUM(b.amount_usd) AS total_amount_usd
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_BREAKS b
WHERE b.break_status IN ('OPEN', 'INVESTIGATING')
GROUP BY b.owner_team
ORDER BY total_amount_usd DESC

results.question: Daily notional this week
results.sql:
SELECT t.trade_date, SUM(t.notional_usd) AS total_notional_usd
FROM TRADE_OPS.CORE.FACT_TRADES t
WHERE t.trade_status <> 'CANCELLED'
  AND t.trade_date BETWEEN '2026-11-16' AND '2026-11-20'
GROUP BY t.trade_date
ORDER BY trade_date
